answer.new_information: NN reportedly announced 47 additional machine centers for liquid-cooling production at its Wuxi plant for NVIDIA AI data-center racks. This is a supplier-capacity development, not evidence that NVIDIA confirmed the order, that the capacity has begun production, or that products have shipped. The research scope is NVDA, and no linked questions or stored pieces were supplied. Other supplied pieces concern separate claims: pre-sold capacity (item:e2), a 2026 business target (item:e3), index removal (item:e4), and 2028 projections (items:e5 and e6).
